# <span id="aanchor451"></span> FcDebug Options

FLOWCAL Debug (FcDebug) Options provide additional capabilities for troubleshooting and advanced configuration. Options related to the File Import service are often used for moving or archiving files after being processed. Troubleshooting options are sometimes provided by Customer Support to temporarily enable when investigating issues.

These options are configured in the FcDebugOptions.cfg file in the FLOWCAL installation directory. You can open and modify the file using any text editing tool, such as Notepad.

The CFG file is initially named "FcDebugOptions_Template.cfg". You will need to remove the word "Template" from the file name when configuring options in the file. It is shipped with FLOWCAL with "Template" in the name so that your settings will not be overwritten during an upgrade or re-installation.

## File Format

Debug options are organized into sections in the FcDebugOptions file. Each section begins with a designated service name, user name, or other generic entries.

<div class="example">

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerBRDToggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_BRDToggler MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Example-File Format 1">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Example</a>

<div style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Example-File Format 1">

\[ALL_USERS\]

\[JOHN.DOE\]

\[FCSRVFILEIMPORT\]

 

</div>

</div>

Section designators must appear on lines by themselves, in square brackets, with the associated parameters listed below it. Each associated parameter has a name and a value separated by an equal sign. The name is specified on the left and the value on the right.

<div class="example">

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerBRDToggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_BRDToggler MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Example-File Format 2">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Example</a>

<div style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Example-File Format 2">

\[FCSRVFILEIMPORT.EXE\]

FileImportPath = \\server1\C\FCMeterFileImport

 

</div>

</div>

Sections do not have designated end points, but new sections can be started at any point.

## File Import Options

The FcDebugOptions.cfg file is used to configure various File Import service options, such as importing from multiple directories and archiving processed files. These supported options are listed below.

To create a section in FcDebugOptions.cfg for a file import service to use these options, enter an open bracket, the exact file name of the service, and a closed bracket. Enter the applicable options on the subsequent lines.

<div class="example">

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerBRDToggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_BRDToggler MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Example-File Import">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Example</a>

If you are running two file import services, FcSrvFileImport.exe and FcSrvFileImport2.exe, you can configure options for the first service by entering “\[FcSrvFileImport.exe\]”, and listing the required parameters. You could then configure options for the second service by entering “\[FcSrvFileImport2.exe\]”, and listing the required parameters.

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Import Path 1">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />FileImportPath_1</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Import Path 1">

Specify a file path for the file import service to look for files to import other than the path specified on the Service Configuration screen (e.g., \\server1\C\FCMeterFileImport).

<div class="example">

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerBRDToggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_BRDToggler MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Example-File Import Path">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Example</a>

<div style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Example-File Import Path">

\[FCSRVFILEIMPORT2.EXE\]

FileImportPath_1 = \\server1\C\FCMeterFileImport

 

</div>

</div>

To use this option, the designated service name parameter must have the executable (.exe) extension designator following the service name.

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Import Path 2">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />FileImportPath_2</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Import Path 2">

Specify an additional file path for the file import service to look for files to import other than the path specified in the Service Configuration screen (e.g., E:\cfxfiles).

<div class="example">

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerBRDToggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_BRDToggler MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Example-File Import Path 2">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Example</a>

<div style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Example-File Import Path 2">

\[FCSRVFILEIMPORT2.EXE\]

FileImportPath_1 = \\server1\C\FCMeterFileImport

FileImportPath_2 = E:\cfxfiles

 

</div>

</div>

To use this option, the designated service name parameter must have the executable (.exe) extension designator following the service name.

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Successfully Processed">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Successfully_Processed_File_Action</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Successfully Processed">

Specify how to handle processed files. By default, the File Import service will leave the files where they are once they are processed. Other options are:

- **A** - Move files to default archive folder (this will automatically create a folder in the file import path called zzzProcessedFiles)
- **M** - Move files to specified target folder (see <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Successfully Processed 2">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />successfully_processed_files_target_folder</a> option)
- **D** - Delete the file

<div class="example">

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerBRDToggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_BRDToggler MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Example-Successfully Processed">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Example</a>

<div style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Example-Successfully Processed">

\[FcSrvFileImport.exe\]

successfully_processed_file_action = A

 

</div>

</div>

To use this option, the designated service name parameter must have the executable (.exe) extension designator following the service name.

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Successfully Processed 2">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Successfully_Processed_Files_Target_Folder</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Successfully Processed 2">

If the option successfully\_ processed\_ file_action = M is used, use this option to define where the files will be moved to once they are successfully processed. If no location is specified, then the default location will be used.

<div class="example">

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerBRDToggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_BRDToggler MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Example-Successfully Processed 2">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Example</a>

<div style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Example-Successfully Processed 2">

\[FcSrvFileImport.exe\]

successfully_processed_file_action = M

successfully_processed_files_target_folder = \\svr_001\processed_files\\

 

</div>

</div>

To use this option, the designated service name parameter must not have the executable (.exe) extension designator following the service name.

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Target Folder Plus">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Target_Folder_Plus_Day</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Target Folder Plus">

This option will create a folder per day (YYYY_MM_DD) in the target folder. Options are:

- **Y** - Enabled
- **N** - Disabled

<div class="example">

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerBRDToggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_BRDToggler MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Example-Target Folder">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Example</a>

<div style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Example-Target Folder">

\[FcSrvFileImport.exe\]

successfully_processed_file_action = M

successfully_processed_files_target_folder = \\svr_001\processed_files\\

target_folder_plus_day = Y/N

 

</div>

</div>

To use this option, the designated service name parameter must not have the executable (.exe) extension designator following the service name.

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Unmapped File Action">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Unmapped_File_Action</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Unmapped File Action">

When a file is unable to import because it is not mapped to a meter, use this option to specify a file extension as an identifier on the file. Options are:

- **U** - Change extension to \_U_xxx
- **F** - Change extension to \_F_xxx (default behavior for failed files)

<div class="example">

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerBRDToggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_BRDToggler MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Example-Unmapped File Action">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Example</a>

<div style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Example-Unmapped File Action">

\[FcSrvFileImport.exe\]

successfully_processed_file_action = M

successfully_processed_files_target_folder = \\svr_001\processed_files\\

target_folder_plus_day = Y/N

unmapped_file_action = U

 

</div>

</div>

 

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Unmapped Files Target">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Unmapped_Files_Target_Folder</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Unmapped Files Target">

When a file is unable to import because it is not mapped to a meter, use this option to specify a folder where the file will be moved to.

<div class="example">

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerBRDToggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_BRDToggler MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Example-Unmapped File Target">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Example</a>

<div style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Example-Unmapped File Target">

\[FcSrvFileImport.exe\]

successfully_processed_file_action = M

successfully_processed_files_target_folder = \\svr_001\processed_files\\

target_folder_plus_day = Y/N

unmapped_file_action = U

unmapped_files_target_folder = \\svr_001\unmapped_files

 

</div>

</div>

 

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Failed File">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Failed_File_Action</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Failed File">

Specify how to handle failed files after renaming them. By default, the File Import service will leave the files where they are once they are processed. Other options are:

- **A** - Move file to default archive folder (\zFailedFilesArchive)
- **M** - Move to specified target folders

<div class="example">

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerBRDToggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_BRDToggler MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Example-Failed File">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Example</a>

<div style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Example-Failed File">

\[FcSrvFileImport.exe\]

successfully_processed_file_action = M

successfully_processed_files_target_folder = \\svr_001\processed_files\\

target_folder_plus_day = Y/N

unmapped_file_action = U

unmapped_files_target_folder = \\svr_001\unmapped_files

failed_file_action = A

 

</div>

</div>

To use this option, the designated service name parameter must not have the executable (.exe) extension designator following the service name.

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Failed Files Target">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Failed_Files_Target_Folder</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Failed Files Target">

If the option failed_file_action = M is used, use this option to specify where failed files will be moved to. If no location is specified, the default location will be used.

<div class="example">

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerBRDToggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_BRDToggler MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Example-Failed File Target">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Example</a>

<div style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Example-Failed File Target">

\[FcSrvFileImport.exe\]

successfully_processed_file_action = M

successfully_processed_files_target_folder = \\svr_001\processed_files\\

target_folder_plus_day = Y/N

unmapped_file_action = U

unmapped_files_target_folder = \\svr_001\unmapped_files

failed_file_action = M

failed_files_target_folder = \\svr_001\failed_files\\

 

</div>

</div>

To use this option, the designated service name parameter must not have the executable (.exe) extension designator following the service name.

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Process Single File">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Process_Single_File_Per_Folder</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Process Single File">

This option allows the File Import service to independently process each CFX file in a subdirectory. This means that files are not merged into a composite CFX during processing. The results are not representative of a typical folder import; however, the process does mimic the import process that would have occurred had the SCADA system provided the files one-by-one instead of in bulk. Options are:

- **Y** - Enabled
- **N** - Disabled

<div class="example">

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerBRDToggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_BRDToggler MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Example-Single File">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Example</a>

<div style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Example-Single File">

\[FcSrvFileImport.exe\]

successfully_processed_file_action = M

successfully_processed_files_target_folder = \\svr_001\processed_files\\

target_folder_plus_day = Y/N

unmapped_file_action = U

unmapped_files_target_folder = \\svr_001\unmapped_files

failed_file_action = M

failed_files_target_folder = \\svr_001\failed_files\\

process_single_file_per_folder = Y/N

 

</div>

</div>

To use this option, the designated service name parameter must not have the executable (.exe) extension designator following the service name.

</div>

## Location Rollup Options

To create a section in the FcDebugOptions.cfg file for a location rollup service to use these options, enter an open bracket, the exact file name of the service, followed by a closed bracket. Enter the applicable options on the subsequent lines.

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Rollup ID Processing Instance">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />rollup_id_processing_instance</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Rollup ID Processing Instance">

Defines the service instance in which the fc_location_time_frame.rollup_report_id columns are calculated. If the defined service is not running, locations that have been edited and now have NULL fc_location_time_frame.rollup_report_id values will not roll up. The default value is 2 when the service count is 2 or greater.

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Rollup Child Locations First">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />rollup_child_locations_first</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Rollup Child Locations First">

Enables location rollups optimization that rolls up child locations with queue entries before rolling up the current location. The default value is "Y"; set to "N" to disable the option.

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Rollup Child Location Limits">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />rollup_child_location_limit</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Rollup Child Location Limits">

Sets the maximum number of child location rollups.

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Max Location Child Rollup">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />max_location_child_rollup_depth</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Max Location Child Rollup">

Sets the maximum depth level for child location rollups. Defaults to a depth of 3.

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Rollup Parent After Hidden">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />rollup_parent_after_hidden_sublocation</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Rollup Parent After Hidden">

When a hidden sub-location is rolled, its parent real location will be rolled next. If sibling hidden sub-location queue entries exist, they will be rolled before the parent when the rollup_child_locations_first option is enabled. The default value is "Y"; set to N to disable the option.

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Output Tieover Members">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />output_tieover_members</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Output Tieover Members">

Log calculated canceling tieover time frames to file (default is "N").

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Show Performance Messages">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />show_performance_messages</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Show Performance Messages">

Display timing messages for the service. When this is "N" (default), only the location being rolled and any error or warning messages will be displayed.

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Old Tieover Processing Instance">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />old_tieover_processing_instance</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Old Tieover Processing Instance">

Indicates the location rollups service instance that will perform the legacy tieover handling used to hide canceled tieover and transfer members in FLOWCAL. The default is the service instance count, which is effectively the last service.

</div>

## Miscellaneous Options

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Password Expire">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />password_expire_warning_threshold</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Password Expire">

Specifies the number of days to receive the warning stating the user’s password is expiring. By default, the number of days is set to 14 from the date of expiration.

<div class="example">

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerBRDToggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_BRDToggler MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Example-Password Expire">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Example</a>

<div style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Example-Password Expire">

\[ALL_USERS\]

PASSWORD_EXPIRE_WARNING_THRESHOLD = 14

</div>

</div>

</div>
